title: Vani Veena Pustaka Pani - Hindolam - Adi
name: Vani Veena Pustaka Pani

ragas.name: Hindolam
ragas.was: Hindolam - S G1 M1 D1 N1 S’ - S’ N1 D1 M1 G1 S

text: Goddess Saraswati, the creator of sound (vANI), who carries the veena (veeNA) and books (pustaka) in her hands (pANI), shower (phaladE) us with boons (vAnchita). You have a charming (bhAsura) look, are praised (vinutE) by deities (vAsava) and worshipped (prItE) by rajas (bhUsura) in the world, and have a virtuous history (SubhacaritE). You are dear (prItE) to the praises (nuta) of deities (sura). You are so fortunate (suruchira) that the lotus (padma) bears you. Give us happiness (mAdE) and a good reputation (khyAtE). We praise (vEDeda) you (tE).

Goddess Saraswati, the creator of sound, who carries the veena and books in her hands, shower us with boons. You have a charming look, are praised by deities and worshipped by rajas in the world, and have a virtuous history. You are dear to deities. You are so fortunate that the lotus bears you. Give us happiness and a good reputation.
